environment.description: Same ECS Fargate service consuming from the same SQS queue. However, all messages entering the queue originate exclusively from a REST API exposed through Amazon API Gateway (HTTP API type, not REST API). The API Gateway route POST /v1/orders has a request validation configuration with a JSON Schema model applied to the request body. The schema defines the order payload as a JSON object with properties orderId (string, pattern ^[A-Z0-9-]{8,36}$), customerId (string, pattern ^CUS-[0-9]{6,12}$), productCode (string, pattern ^[A-Z]{2,4}-[0-9]{4}$), quantity (integer, minimum 1, maximum 9999), and shippingAddress (string, maxLength 256, pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9\s,.-]{1,256}$). additionalProperties is set to false. The content-type is enforced as application/json. A Lambda transformer between the API Gateway and SQS converts the validated JSON into the XML format expected by the consumer using a hardcoded template with String.format() — no user-controlled XML structure passes through. The SQS queue access policy restricts SendMessage to only the Lambda execution role ARN. The API Gateway has no XML content-type support configured.

config.request_validation: enabled with JSON Schema model on POST /v1/orders
config.content_type_enforcement: application/json only, XML content-types rejected at gateway level
config.lambda_transformer: converts validated JSON to XML via String.format template, no user XML passes through
config.sqs_access_policy: SendMessage restricted to Lambda execution role ARN only
config.network: VPC with no NAT gateway, VPC endpoints for SQS and CloudWatch only
